notes.title: Update patch 1.0.3 🛠️
notes.notes:
Thank you to all the players for supporting us!



We have fixed the following details:

Corrected Thai spelling errors

Fixed the link to our support page

Fixed skipping the Normal End and True End scenes using the Start button on a gamepad

Fixed the bug where the character could turn left/right with a gamepad while the game was paused

Fixed the Bad End achievement so it now triggers from the start of the Mira & Sophia scene
